visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a blue checkered shirt stands outdoors at a busy street market during the day. She speaks enthusiastically toward the camera with a wide smile and expressive facial movements. Behind her, a food stall with a bright red and yellow awning is visible, illuminated by natural sunlight. Yellow and red subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to an evening setting at a temple courtyard decorated with numerous glowing red lanterns. The woman holds a massive, light brown steamed bun wrapped in a clear plastic bag next to her head to demonstrate its extreme size. Her hands grip the plastic firmly as she showcases the food item. (3) A man in a grey athletic t-shirt with a mountain brand logo takes over the presentation, holding the large bun. He points at the texture of the steamed bread while speaking directly to the lens. The background remains the temple area with warm artificial lighting from the hanging lanterns. (4) The man takes a large bite of the brown sugar steamed bun while nodding in satisfaction. Close-up shots highlight the internal airy texture of the torn bread. A graphic of a 50-dollar coin and various text overlays in yellow and white appear to emphasize the price and his reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice speaks rapidly in Traditional Chinese, expressing excitement. An upbeat electronic pop background music track with a driving 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer textures plays continuously. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as text graphics slide onto the screen. (2) High-frequency crinkling sounds of a plastic bag are heard as the food item is manipulated. The background music remains steady. A playful 'pop' sound effect accentuates the appearance of variety-style captions. The female speaker's prosody is highly dynamic with frequent rising intonations. (3) The vocal switches to a male speaker with a deeper, mid-range pitch and a casual, friendly tone. He speaks at a moderate pace. The background music continues at the same tempo but volume is slightly lowered behind his voice. Occasional soft 'thud' sounds indicate the bun being tapped. (4) A short, muted crunching sound is heard as the man takes a bite. A metallic 'ding' sound effect plays when a coin graphic appears visually. The male voice continues with a relaxed, smiling quality. The ambient room tone is clean with minimal interference.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and showcase a giant brown sugar steamed bun found at the Y2K beverage stall in Zhushan. The creators highlight the food's massive size relative to a human head, its affordable price (50 TWD), and its high quality and fragrance despite its scale.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While a location '竹山Y2K飲料豆花站' and a brand 'COXCO' are mentioned, the tone is a casual food discovery vlog rather than a paid commercial endorsement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing with frequent text overlays and variety-show style sound effects. The video uses size comparison as a visual hook.
